summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running anything, and nothing is committed. Changed files: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coords) pairs with coords as int arrays of shape (ndim, 2) in the unpadded frame; set_rnd skips dunder attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; GridPatchDataset rewritten with patch_iter/transform/with_coordinates, np.ceil worker split, exact NotImplementedError message, apply_transform with map_items=False; PatchDataset docstring uses float; math import removed; PatchIter in __all__), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc after GridPatchDataset), and new tests/test_grid_dataset.py (TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape and test_loading_array, using the pinned values from the spec). Two things to check when tests are run: (1) with np.arange(16) images, the pinned first-patch values look like the region at rows 0-1, cols 0-1, not the expected coordinates (dim2 [2,4]), so the image contents or pinned values may need re-deriving; (2) the two-worker pinned values depend on RNG order and are unverified. Lines over 120 characters remain only in the pre-existing get_valid_patch_size docstring, which is out of scope.
